objectives.text: Recognize which Java release a feature needs, such as lambdas (8), var (10), switch expressions (14) and records (16)
Rewrite an older idiom, such as an anonymous class or a colon switch, in its modern form
Inspect a short Java 8, 11 or 17 example, predict whether it compiles on JDK 25, and name the feature or migration issue behind the prediction

minutes.basis: Intake planning budget for a review page under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (B8): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are 0 (not measured), not estimates. The planning value is the largest ceil(max(estimator P50, worst path)) measured on a course-1 page (10 minutes, agile-scrum-user-stories). The module PR measures the authored page with the frozen estimator, models the worst required path, and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15, without compressing other topics. See authoring/evidence/java-foundations/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
